author: CollinRugg
text:
Queer Minnesota anchor who shamed Arch Manning for laughing at an AI video is on the verge of tears as she tells her fans that she has been booted from her TV show.

Jana Shortal's voice cracked as she told her followers she was demoted to online only. 

You love to see it.
